outer.selectionReason: EK's front cover was retained because its destination-led Japanese headline hierarchy remained strong, but its back-cover dominant flat-lay camera/map image still read as generic wedding stock imagery rather than travel editorial. EM is a safe clean-room duplicate that subtracts that object-led dominance and reuses the already accepted same-V5 coast travel image as the full dominant back-cover field, then overlaps two verified support photographs at unequal scale. At thumbnail, whole-reading, and actual-size back-cover scales the full item reads more consistently as a Japanese travel-information magazine while preserving native text, semantic roles, crop editability, rollback state, and the EK front cover.
